lineage.description: Storm surge predictions were generated by the National Operational Assessment of Hazards (NOAH) system for Typhoon Ruby (Hagupit) in December 2014. The model simulates coastal inundation depths based on cyclone track and intensity parameters, producing deterministic spatial predictions of water depth at affected localities.

sources.name: National Operational Assessment of Hazards (NOAH)
sources.description: Philippine government hazard modeling system providing storm surge predictions for tropical cyclones. Generates deterministic inundation depth forecasts for coastal areas.
